purpose: One-shot capability retry proposal for user review only
steps: After separate authorization only, start the development-only server from the repository root with node_modules/.bin/vite --config tools/address-capability/vite.config.ts --mode capability-probe. Open a fresh normal-Chrome page at http://127.0.0.1:5174/. Do not reuse a completed or failed page.
Click Prepare local verification runtime once. Require LOCAL_VERIFIER_READY; otherwise stop and report only the fixed result.
Click Discover injected wallets once and explicitly select the intended 1AM entry. Do not select another wallet or the first entry by default.
Check product version 6.3.11 in extension management separately. Require entry 1am, rdns com.midnight.1am and connector API 4.0.0. Identifiers alone do not prove authenticity. Stop on any mismatch.
Click Connect selected wallet to Preprod once and approve only the single expected connection request from http://127.0.0.1:5174. Both connected status and configuration must say preprod.
Immediately stop on any fixed connection, address, method or network failure. Do not reconnect, reload to retry, switch wallets, or bypass an error.

Only if overall is CONNECTED, read the nontransactional capability disclosure and use the separate Sign click once. This is the public capability-test domain with a synthetic contract value, never participation evidence.
Reject and stop on any transaction, fee, transfer, contract-call, secret or unexpected request. No automatic or overall retry is permitted.
Report only the allowlisted Redacted result and separately observed product version. Never retain an address, challenge, nonce, signature, key, raw response, exception or wallet-popup screenshot.
After the result, close the page and stop the server. PASSED is terminal, as is failure. A further attempt requires a fresh page and separate authorization.
